import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert categorical variables to numerical variables
customer_segments['Education'] = customer_segments['Education'].map({'Basic': 1, 'Graduation': 2, 'Tertiary': 3})
customer_segments['Marital_Status'] = customer_segments['Marital_Status'].map({'Single': 1, 'Together': 2, 'Divorced': 3, 'Widow': 4})

# Define a function to create a bar plot for categorical variables
def category_bar_chart(x, y, title, xlabel, ylabel):
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    sns.countplot(x=x, hue=y, data=customer_segments)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.xlabel(xlabel)
    plt.ylabel(ylabel)
    plt.legend(title=y)
    plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
    plt.close()

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    sns.histplot(x=x, data=customer_segments, bins=20)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.xlabel(xlabel)
    plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
    plt.close()
